hypothesis: Cloudflare Worker lines 409-410 enforce a strict 7-item whitelist ['attraction', 'food', ...] on PATCH /api/poi/:id/category, causing any custom category protocol 'custom:...' to be forcibly overwritten to 'attraction'.
When category name contains colons (e.g., '下午茶:甜點'), naive string splitting splits into 5+ items, shifting the hex color offset and corrupting UI styles.
Malformed or truncated custom category strings (e.g. 'custom:', 'custom:🍜', 'custom:::') cause index out of bounds or undefined properties in rendering.
Dynamic harvesting across heterogeneous POIs fails to deduplicate identical custom categories or mistakenly includes standard categories, polluting filter tabs.
Map component treats CATEGORY_ICONS[p.category] as a React SVG ElementType, resulting in undefined when rendered with custom category protocol strings.
